title: Truth of the Reduction Formula
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine that decides a language $L$ using space at most $d(n^c+1)$ on every input of length $n$. Let $V$ be a finite-state deterministic Turing machine that, on every Boolean string $y$, outputs the one-bit string whose bit is the predicate defined by the machine $N$ and parameters $d,c$ evaluated at $y$, and halts within $CV(|y|+1)^{c_V}$ steps. Then, for every Boolean string $x$, the quantified Boolean formula $ho(x)$ constructed from $N,d,c,V,CV,c_V$ is true if and only if $x\in L$.
